@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+
+def settlement_day(epoch_seconds: int) -> str:
+    instant = datetime.fromtimestamp(epoch_seconds, tz=timezone.utc)
+    return instant.astimezone().date().isoformat()
+
+
+def statement_key(account_id: str, epoch_seconds: int) -> str:
+    return f"{account_id}/{settlement_day(epoch_seconds)}"

pull_request.body: Settlement keys are used across regions, and the timestamp is already supplied as Unix seconds.
pull_request.title: Group card statements by settlement day

ground_truth.rationale: The conversion with no timezone argument uses the server's local timezone; a transaction near UTC midnight can be assigned to a different statement day depending on deployment location.
